name: Task Manager & Resource Monitor
author: AndroUnderTheHood
description: A Windows-style task manager for Android: processes grouped into apps / system / kernel with CPU, memory, disk and threads; a details list; performance graphs for CPU (per core and frequency), memory, storage, network, GPU and temperatures; and resource-monitor views of per-process CPU, memory, disk I/O and network connections. End task, kill, end process tree, suspend/resume, priority and process details.
